title: New footage
author: True_Woodpecker2118
selftext:
New gameplay footage

So im learning all these new terms being new to this whole AI thing, so i have vibe coded this game. Apparently thats the term, its my game for me, im not selling anything. I dont wanna get into the whole debate, im just showing my baby. Yes im very proud. Using vibe coding for me is quite fun. Im not very optimal with it, im honestly just taking inspiration from multiple retro games i grew up on, and smooshing them together. And i love it. So the AI was used with tesanas type prompt feature, vibe coded. It has built everything then i have gone in and tested and tweaked. Idk if thats enough of a description of the Ai i thought vibe coded covered it.
